login.eyebrow: Common data environment for construction projects
login.headline: The single, trusted source of information for your project.
login.intro: Manage documents, models and site processes in one secure workspace. Bring your teams together around up-to-date information.

documents.title: Document Management
documents.description: Manage revision, approval and distribution processes traceably.

coordination.title: BIM Coordination
coordination.description: Review models together and track clashes and issues.

workflows.title: Controlled Workflows
workflows.description: Keep forms, reviews and project decisions in one place.

login.trust: Secure, auditable project management built around ISO 19650
login.title: Sign In to Your Account
login.description: Continue securely to your project workspace.

errors.accountNotAllowed: This Google account has no access to SiteKeep.
errors.googleCancelled: Signing in with Google was cancelled.
errors.googleFailed: Signing in with Google could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.googleDisabled: Signing in with Google is turned off on this server (Administration → Privacy Centre).
errors.invitationEmailMismatch: The Google account has another e-mail address than the invitation. Choose the invited address in Google, or accept with a password.
errors.invitationClosed: The invitation can no longer be used (expired, accepted or withdrawn).
errors.oidcDisabled: This sign-in method is turned off on this server (Administration → Sign-in Security or Privacy Centre).
errors.oidcCancelled: Signing in was cancelled at the identity provider.
errors.oidcFailed: Signing in with the identity provider could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.oidcNoEmail: The identity provider did not send an e-mail address. Ask your system administrator to check the claim mapping.
errors.oidcEmailNotVerified: The identity provider has not verified your e-mail address.
errors.oidcDomainNotAllowed: Your e-mail address is not in a domain allowed for this sign-in method.
errors.oidcAccountNotAllowed: This account has no access to SiteKeep. Ask your system administrator for an invitation.

forcePassword.title: Change Your Password
forcePassword.description: A temporary password was set for your first sign-in. Choose your own password to continue.
forcePassword.descriptionNamed: {{name}}, a temporary password was set for your first sign-in. Choose your own password to continue.

messages.changed: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.

emailNotifications.heading: E-mail notifications
emailNotifications.description: SiteKeep e-mails you about review steps and work items. Choose per type: follow the project's default, always send, or never send. Notifications inside SiteKeep are not affected. Nothing is sent when your administrator has not set up e-mail.
emailNotifications.projectDescription: Default for project members who made no choice of their own under Account > E-mail notifications. Everyone can still change it for themselves.

assigned.label: Assigned to me
assigned.help: A review step or a work item (RFI, technical approval, correspondence, action) is assigned to you, or it is your company's turn.

due_soon.label: Due soon
due_soon.help: A step or work item waiting for you is due within a day.

overdue.label: Overdue
overdue.help: A step or work item waiting for you (or one you started) is past its due date.

outcome.label: Outcome
outcome.help: A review you started is decided (approved, approved with comments, revise, rejected), or a work item you opened is decided.

delegation.label: Delegation
delegation.help: When an approval delegation given to you or by you starts or ends, or when open items are handed over to the delegate.

tokens.heading: API Access Tokens
tokens.description: AECPilot "Submit", MCP clients (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cline, Open WebUI…) and scripts connect with these access tokens using your permissions. An access token is shown only once, when it is created.
tokens.notAllowed: {{reason}} If you need an access token, contact your project or system administrator.

new.heading: New Access Token
new.readWriteBlocked: Read + Write (not allowed by the administrator)
new.copyNow: Copy the access token now; it will not be shown again:

connector.heading: Run with My Own Claude/Cursor Subscription
connector.description: After creating a Read + Write token, run the connector in the repo folder. Cursor connects to your account through the browser on the first command; the Claude option uses the existing Claude Code session on your computer.

mcp.heading: Connect with MCP (other AI clients)
mcp.description: For Claude Code, use the command below; in other clients enter the same address and Authorization header as a "Streamable HTTP" server.

apps.heading: Connected Applications
apps.description: OpenCDE applications you approved (Solibri, BCF tools…) connect with your permissions. Removing access invalidates all of the application's access tokens; the application asks for approval again next time.

invite.title: Accept Your Invitation
invite.intro: {{inviter}} invited you to {{projects}}. Set your name and password to open your account.
invite.introNoInviter: You are invited to {{projects}}. Set your name and password to open your account.
invite.expires: The invitation is valid until {{date}} and can be used once.
invite.signedInAs: You are signed in as {{name}} ({{email}}); accepting signs you in with the new account.

errors.noToken: The link has no invitation code. Open the link from the invitation again.

reasons.smtp_not_configured: No e-mail server is configured: hand this link to the person (valid for 14 days, works once).
reasons.smtp_disabled: E-mail is switched off in the Privacy Centre: hand this link to the person (valid for 14 days, works once).
reasons.send_failed: The e-mail could not be sent: hand this link to the person (valid for 14 days, works once).

signIn.title: Two-factor authentication
signIn.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
signIn.recoveryDescription: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works once.
signIn.enrolDescription: Your administrator requires two-factor authentication. Set it up now to finish signing in.

setup.scan: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (for example Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator or 1Password), then enter the code it shows.
setup.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
setup.manual: Cannot scan? Enter this key in the app:

recovery.title: Your recovery codes
recovery.description: Keep these codes somewhere safe. If you lose your phone, each code lets you sign in once. They are shown only now.

account.heading: Two-factor authentication
account.description: After your password (or Google), SiteKeep also asks for a code from an authenticator app on your phone. API access tokens are not affected.

sessions.heading: Sessions
sessions.description_one: You are signed in on {{count}} browser.
sessions.description_other: You are signed in on {{count}} browsers.

endAll.title: Sign out everywhere
endAll.confirm: All your browser sessions end, this one included. API access tokens keep working.

privacyNotice.title: Privacy Notice
privacyNotice.ack: I Have Read the Privacy Notice
privacyNotice.required: Read the privacy notice and tick “I Have Read the Privacy Notice” to continue.
